facts.text: Saalfelden am Steinernen Meer is a town in the Zell am See district of the Austrian state of Salzburg, in the historic Pinzgau region.
The Steinernes Meer, the karst plateau in the town's full name, is part of the Berchtesgaden Alps.
Zermatt lies at the head of the Matter Valley in the Swiss canton of Valais.
The town bans combustion-engine cars, apart from some emergency, municipal and permitted vehicles, and most visitors arrive by rack railway.
